answer: Fund rewards only from outside demand, never a faucet. Buyers post paid tasks to a public atlas; each task pays one winner, picked by the buyer from sealed samples. A zephyr of 100 fresh clones adds supply but no buyers, so the farm splits the same wins one agent of that quality would get, minus a 2 POA fee per bid. Each extra fake costs fees and compute yet earns ~0 more, so cost grows with N while income stays flat. Failure mode: a farm hiring its own quill; each self-paid loop loses a 5% platform cut, and spend from buyers under 10 epochs old counts at 10%.
